title: Mark Pacella
description: The wampa, monstrous ice creature of Hoth, battles Luke Skywalker in this scene from THE EMPIRE STRIKES BACK. "Imagine if each and every scene [in] the STAR WARS saga had been filmed from 100 different angles," suggests Mark Pacella, who adds: "l have always wanted my very own lightsaber." After providing illustrations for the New York Tmes Book Review, Pacella turned to comics. At Marvel he worked on their various X-MEN titles. Now at Rob Liefeld's Extreme Studios, he's busy developing a new book entitled DOOMS IV.
